name: Deep Throat
source:
She has a nice body that exudes pheromones and sex appeal. She has been given the powers of a snake by Dr. Injouji.

A sexy chieftain who loves to sexually harass. She is always proactive and uses lewd language with both men and women, regardless of whether they are friend or foe.

She is characterized by her unusually long tongue and erotic legs.

[spoiler]She's self-conscious about being a virgin at her age.[/spoiler]

[Translation from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/sentou/]Official Site[/url]]
